Marrow Agrisupply is on 40 seats, and I've answered Hollis in a reply thread on his #central-team message.

- **Where 40 comes from:** the Affiliate Amendment, effective 2025-10-15, sets Agrisupply at 40 seats on SLA Tier 1. The 2026 renewal order form (signed 22 Apr 2026, effective 1 May 2026, running to 30 Apr 2027) left Agrisupply's seats unchanged. The MAS account page, updated 2026-09-15, also says 40.
- **Fieldworks vs Agrisupply:** the 95 seats in that renewal belong to Marrow Fieldworks, not Agrisupply.
- **The 382 figure:** Tobias posted it on the 14th, but no document in the brain backs it up, and no one has posted a correction in the channel since. I told Hollis to use 40 unless Tobias or June can show a document that changed it.

I shared only seat counts and dates; no pricing went into the channel.

One problem: an earlier summary of mine also went into #central-team as a separate message (ts 1792159200.000125? no — ts 1791986400.000125). It mentions that the order form has a per-seat price, though not the price itself. It may be worth deleting.
